_comment: Paragraph two: the permanent thing about you that makes today land here.
Keyed area then natal point. This file replaced touches.json, which was
keyed by natal point and tone alone, and the rekeying is the whole point.
── Why the old key could not work ──
An aspect's area comes from where the natal point sits. Which area that
is differs per person: one reader's Venus lives in their money sector,
another's in their self sector, another's in their talk sector. One table
keyed by the point alone is therefore one sentence that has to be true
whether the card above it says Money, Self or Talk, so it could only ever
talk about wanting in the abstract. Sixty sentences, no houses, generic
by construction rather than by bad writing.
The exception proved it. The Ascendant is always the first sector and the
Midheaven always the tenth, for everybody, and those two were the only
entries in the old table that read specific: 'what you do and what you
are known for have come apart' is unmistakably a Work sentence. The ten
planets could not do that because their address did not know the house.
── What this file is ──
Ninety-two paragraphs, one per reachable (area, point) pair: ten planets
across nine areas, plus the Ascendant in self and the Midheaven in work,
which are the only areas those two can ever fall in. Writing the other
sixteen would be writing copy no reader can reach.
Each one says the same kind of thing: this part of you lives in this part
of your life, permanently, and here is what that means about you. It is
the most personal paragraph on the card, because unlike the reading above
it, it was true before today and will be true after it.
── Rules ──
Plain language, second person, no astrology and no planet names: the card
prints those from the chart. Say something a reader would recognise about
themselves, in the furniture of that area of life. It must not restate
the reading above it, which is about today; this is about always.
Full rules in CORPUS-RULES.md section 7.

self.sun: The part of you that wants to be recognised lives in the part of your chart about how you arrive. Recognition and first impressions are one subject for you, which is why being read wrongly stings more than it logically should.
self.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in how you come across. Your mood is visible before you have said anything, and people tend to read it as an opinion about them rather than as weather.
self.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about first impressions. People decide what you are like from your phrasing rather than from your content, which is unfair and worth knowing.
self.venus: What you are drawn to sits in how you arrive. Your taste is the first thing people meet, and they read it as a statement about them. It almost never is.
self.mars: Your push lives in how you land on a room. You arrive faster than you mean to, and what feels like ordinary directness from the inside often reads as heat to somebody meeting you.
self.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in how you come across. You take up more room than you think you do, which is an advantage most of the time and a thing to watch when somebody quieter is in the room.
self.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in how you arrive. You come across as more serious than you feel, and people hand you responsibility long before they hand you warmth.
self.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in how you come across. People find you hard to summarise, which costs you in first meetings and pays you back in the second and third.
self.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in how you arrive. People project onto you easily, so what they describe back to you is often a picture of themselves. Take it as information about them.
self.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in how you come across. You are more intense at rest than most people manage on purpose, and a room registers it before you have done anything at all.
self.ascendant: How you land on a room is not something you do, it is what happens before you have done anything. This is the most direct address in your whole chart: an angle here is about you rather than about your work, your money or anybody else.

money.sun: What you want to be recognised for sits in the part of your chart about earning. Being paid properly and being seen properly are one feeling for you, which is why a low number reads as an insult rather than as an opening position.
money.moon: What you need in order to feel settled lives in the part of your chart about money. Your balance sets your mood more directly than it sets your options, and the two get confused most on the days it dips.
money.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about money. You price better in writing than out loud, and the figure you type is reliably higher than the one you would say to somebody's face.
money.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about what you own. You buy for pleasure rather than for use. That is not a fault, and it does mean your budget works better when the pleasure is built into it on purpose.
money.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about earning. You make money in bursts rather than steadily, and the flat weeks in between feel like failure when they are just the shape of how you work.
money.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about money. You are generous, and you are optimistic about what is coming. Those two together are exactly why the arithmetic is worth doing on paper.
money.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about earning. Money feels like a test you could fail, so you underprice and overprepare. The caution is real and it has been quietly costing you the rate.
money.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about money. Your income does not come from one place and it probably never will, which is why the attempts to force it into a single salary have felt wrong.
money.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about money. You would rather not look at the exact figure, and the not looking has cost you more than anything the figure has ever said.
money.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about what you own. Money is about safety rather than comfort for you, which is why losing a small amount can feel like losing a foundation.

talk.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about talking. You are known for what you say rather than for what you have built, so an offhand line does more work in your life than a finished thing.
talk.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about the people you run with. You need a reply more than you need an answer, and a slow one gets read as a verdict when it is usually just a busy week.
talk.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about talking, which is the most at home this gets. Explaining is where you think, so a conversation is not your report on a decision, it is how the decision gets made.
talk.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about the people around you. You collect people the way other people collect objects, and you are better at keeping them than you give yourself credit for.
talk.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about talking. You argue faster than you intend to and it reads as heat rather than as interest, which is a shame, because it usually is interest.
talk.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about the people you run with. Your circle is wider than most and thinner in places, and the maintenance you skip is always on the ones who never chase you.
talk.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about talking. You are the one who answers. It is quietly why people rely on you, and almost never what they thank you for.
talk.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about your people. Friendships arrive suddenly here and rearrange themselves every few years, and the ones that survive that are the real ones.
talk.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about talking. You hear the tone rather than the words, which makes you unusually perceptive and unusually easy to wound with a badly typed message.
talk.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about the people around you. You keep few friendships and they go all the way down, which is why a fallout here takes years rather than weeks.

home.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about home. You want to be somebody in your own house, and being treated as the person you were at fifteen is why family visits tire you more than they should.
home.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about where you sleep, which is the most literal version of this there is. Your home is not a backdrop, it is equipment. A bad room genuinely makes a bad month.
home.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about home. The family conversations go better in writing than in the kitchen, and you have almost certainly never tried the writing.
home.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about the place you live. You make rooms nice as a way of saying things you do not say out loud, and the people you live with mostly do not translate it.
home.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about home. Your drive goes up when you walk through the door rather than down, which is why resting there is hard and why the arguments there start faster than anywhere else.
home.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about home. You want a bigger place, more people in it, more of everything, and the version you actually enjoy is usually one size smaller than the one you plan.
home.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about home. You inherited responsibility young or took it early, and putting it down feels like abandonment rather than like rest.
home.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about where you live. You move, or you rearrange, and staying still in one place for years takes deliberate effort rather than happening on its own.
home.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about home. The story of where you are from has been edited, by you and by everybody else, and the edits are old enough now to be invisible.
home.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about family. Something here does not get discussed, and it shapes more of how you live than anything that does get discussed.

making.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about making things. You need your fingerprints on the work, and anonymous good work leaves you flatter than mediocre work with your name on it.
making.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about making. Making is not a hobby for you, it is regulation, which is why the weeks you make nothing go strange in ways you blame on other things.
making.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about making. Your ideas arrive as sentences rather than as pictures, so the fastest way into a stuck piece is to describe it out loud to somebody.
making.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about making things. Your taste runs ahead of your technique, which is uncomfortable, entirely normal, and the only reason you will ever get better.
making.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about making. You start well and fast, and the middle is where it goes, every time, which means the fix is never more enthusiasm at the beginning.
making.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about making things. Every project grows during the planning, and the one you actually finish is always the one you cut in half before starting.
making.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about making. You judge the work harder than anybody else ever will. That standard is why it is good and why so little of it gets shown.
making.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about making things. You do not repeat yourself, which keeps the work alive and makes it hard to build an audience that knows what to expect.
making.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about making. The idea in your head will always be better than the thing on the page. That does not resolve, and it is not a reason to stop.
making.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about making things. You have no casual projects. Everything you start takes more of you than you budgeted for, so start fewer of them.

work.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about work. Your job and your sense of yourself are not separate, which is why a bad week at work feels like a bad week at being a person.
work.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about the daily work. The atmosphere of the room matters more to you than the work does, and you would leave a good job over a bad one and struggle to explain it.
work.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about work. You get hired for what you can explain rather than for what you can do, and those two have never been the same thing.
work.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about work. You need to like the people, and no amount of money has ever made up for a team you cannot stand.
work.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about the daily work. You work in sprints and cannot pretend otherwise for long, so the job that suits you has real deadlines in it rather than steady hours.
work.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about work. You say yes to more than fits, and it has mostly worked out, which is why you keep doing it and why the schedule keeps breaking.
work.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about work, which is the most literal version of this there is. You are the one who does it properly. It built your reputation and it made you very hard to interrupt.
work.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about work. You have not had a conventional path and you are not going to, and every attempt to force one has ended the same way.
work.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about work. You are unclear about what you actually want from a job, which is why the offers you accept tend to be the ones somebody else described best.
work.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about work. You either own it completely or you cannot make yourself care, and there has never been much available in between.
work.midheaven: Your standing is not a part of you so much as the part other people can see from a distance: what gets said about you when you are not in the room. Angles here land on the reputation rather than on the workload, which is why one can arrive on a day you did nothing differently.

love.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about the other person. You need to be seen accurately by whoever you are with, and being loved for a version of you that is slightly off is worse than not being loved.
love.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about the other person. You settle through somebody rather than alone. That is a real need rather than a weakness, and it is worth saying out loud early.
love.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about relationships. You fall for how somebody talks, and the ones that end here end over language rather than over conduct.
love.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about the other person, which is the most literal version of this there is. What you want and what you move towards are the same thing here, and that makes you fast and occasionally wrong.
love.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about relationships. You chase, and you lose interest when the chasing stops. Knowing that about yourself is most of the fix.
love.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about the other person. You are generous in relationships and you expect the same scale back, and the mismatch when it does not arrive is the recurring argument.
love.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about relationships. You take commitment seriously enough to delay it, and the caution reads as coldness to anybody who has not been told what it is.
love.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about the other person. You need room inside a relationship rather than instead of one, and the ones that fail here fail because nobody ever said that out loud.
love.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about relationships. You see the potential version of a person very clearly, and it takes you longer than most to notice you have fallen for a forecast.
love.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about the other person. There is no casual setting available here, which is why you either avoid this entirely or go all the way in.

sex.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about closeness. Being wanted and being valued are one signal to you, which is why a quiet stretch in this part of your life lands harder than it should.
sex.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about closeness. You need physical reassurance more than the spoken kind, and asking for it out loud is the thing you have decided is embarrassing when it is the opposite.
sex.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about closeness. Talking about it is how you get there, so somebody who cannot have that conversation will always feel like a wall to you.
sex.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about closeness and what the two of you hold jointly. Wanting and money are wired together for you, which sounds cynical and is mostly just useful to know before you share an account.
sex.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about closeness. Appetite arrives fast and honestly, and the only thing that regularly goes wrong is assuming the other person is on the same clock.
sex.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about closeness. You are open-handed with what is yours and you assume the same in return, which is exactly why the joint arrangement needs saying rather than assuming.
sex.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about closeness. Trust is slow for you and permanent once given, and the people who waited for it are the only ones who ever got the whole of you.
sex.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about closeness. You need this to keep changing shape, and routine here reads to you as the beginning of the end when it is usually just a busy month.
sex.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about closeness. Boundaries dissolve easily for you here, which is the best thing about you in this part of your life and the thing to watch when you are tired.
sex.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about closeness, which is the most literal version of this there is. Nothing here is light for you, and pretending otherwise has never worked for long.

belief.sun: What you want to be recognised for lives in the part of your chart about what you hold true. You want to be known as somebody who thinks well, and being called naive lands harder on you than being called wrong.
belief.moon: What you need in order to feel settled sits in the part of your chart about belief and distance. You need something bigger than the week to hold on to, and the months without one are the months when everything else feels pointless.
belief.mercury: How you put things into words lives in the part of your chart about what you hold true. You work out what you believe by arguing it, which is useful, and it is why people think you are far more certain than you are.
belief.venus: What you are drawn to sits in the part of your chart about the far-off. You are pulled towards places and ideas rather than towards objects, and the money you have never regretted is the money spent on going somewhere.
belief.mars: Your push lives in the part of your chart about belief. You fight for positions rather than for interests, which makes you principled and occasionally has you fighting things that were not attacking you.
belief.jupiter: The part of you that wants more sits in the part of your chart about the far-off, which is the most at home this gets. Your appetite is for scope rather than for detail, and the plans that fail do so on logistics rather than on the idea.
belief.saturn: The part of you that keeps promises lives in the part of your chart about belief. You will not say you believe something until you can defend it, which is rare and honest and makes you sound less convinced than you are.
belief.uranus: The part of you that will not stay put sits in the part of your chart about what you hold true. You have changed your mind about large things more than once, you will again, and it is the most reliable thing about you.
belief.neptune: The part of you where the edges go soft lives in the part of your chart about belief, which is the most at home this gets. What you hold true is felt rather than argued, and translating it for people who want an argument has never gone well.
belief.pluto: The part of you that does not do halves lives in the part of your chart about what you hold true. When a belief of yours goes, it does not get revised, it gets demolished and rebuilt. That has happened before and it will happen again.
